impact.scalability: Through the Mycelium Relay (RSS/JSON), our node acts as an API for the entire SolarPunk movement.

technical.stack: GitHub Actions, Python-based Transparency Engine, SHA256 Hashing, JSON Feed Protocol.
technical.governance: Autonomous code-based mandate (70/30) with human anchor oversight.
technical.innovation: The 'Spore Protocol'—a replicable framework that allows any community to clone a verified mutual aid hub in minutes.

identity.short_desc: An autonomous infrastructure that hashes financial transparency and mandates a 70/30 aid-to-growth ratio.
identity.tagline: SolarPunk Nerve Center: A sovereign node for post-scarcity mutual aid.
identity.full_mission: The Nerve Center exists to manifest SolarPunk principles through radical transparency. By using SHA256 hashing to verify every transaction, we ensure that 70% of all revenue is redirected to humanitarian aid, while 30% fuels decentralized infrastructure.
